title: Noisy experiment contrasts acquire an observable reset under a rank-two contract
status_authority: Selected source bytes and producer-reported internal reviews are preserved. This integration does not promote correctness, novelty, physical capability, priority or practical advantage.
reported_status: The Ultra checkpoint and theorem report an acquired nonselective preparation/reset certificate, with an internally reviewed synthetic rank-two fixture. The claim is conditional on a supplied full controlled Hankel-rank bound and a measured nonzero preparation gap.
scientific_scope_status: For a stationary finite-action process with full controlled Hankel rank at most two, a paid reproducible initializer, legal controls and a successfully acquired gap, the source reports that count-based contrasts identify a positive mixture whose future visible-event/trajectory law has a uniform error certificate over the stated histories and finite feedback protocols. The reset concerns observable future behavior after the record is withheld.

proof_availability.classification_scope: The theorem requires the complete controlled rank promise, acquired nonzero gap and paid initializer. The finite synthetic run and the source-reported internal review do not validate a physical reset or economic advantage.
